round-corners.formula:
radius_px = round(min(width, height) × radius_pct / 100)
corner arc: quarter circle of radius_px at each corner

round-corners.workedExample:
An 800 × 600 px photo with a 10% radius:
shorter side = 600 px
radius_px = round(600 × 10 / 100) = 60 px
Each corner is cut by a 60 px quarter-circle. At 50%, radius_px = 300 px = half the shorter side, giving fully round ends.
